posts.title: Apache Roller: unauthenticated code execution through XML-RPC, being exploited
posts.description: Apache says a flaw in the Roller blog server that lets anyone run code is being exploited. Versions 4.0.0 to 6.1.4 are affected. Update to 6.1.6, or turn off XML-RPC properly.

posts.title: OpenSSH password bypass on some Linux servers, now exploited
posts.description: OpenSSH 10.6p2, released on 5 November 2026, fixes a password bypass on Linux systems built with musl and without PAM, such as some Alpine servers. CISA lists it as exploited.

posts.title: Outlook zero-day: a message file that leaks your Windows password hash
posts.description: Microsoft fixed an exploited Outlook flaw on 10 November 2026. Opening a crafted file can send the user's NTLM hash to an attacker. What it is and what to check.
